action.headline_en: Press 2: Worm wear. Change the worm now.
action.headline_ms: Penekan 2: Haus skru cacing. Tukar skru cacing sekarang.

reasons.text_en: Motor current per tonne is 2% above Press 2's normal
reasons.text_ms: Arus motor setiap tan 2% lebih tinggi daripada biasa bagi Penekan 2

reasons.text_en: 1,972 h since the last logged service on Press 2
reasons.text_ms: 1,972 jam sejak servis terakhir direkodkan bagi Penekan 2

reasons.text_en: Oil lost in fibre is 3.3% (alarm line is 4%)
reasons.text_ms: Kehilangan minyak dalam serabut ialah 3.3% (garis amaran 4%)

diagnosis.plain_en: The screw that squeezes the fruit is wearing thin, so the motor works harder and more oil stays in the fibre.
diagnosis.plain_ms: Skru yang memerah buah semakin haus, jadi motor bekerja lebih kuat dan lebih banyak minyak tertinggal dalam serabut.

steps_en: Plan the change for the next planned stop and tell the crew.
Isolate and lock out the press, then open the press cage.
Measure the worm and cone clearance and compare with the worn limit.
Replace the worm and the cone liner if worn; check the shaft seat.
Close up, run empty for 10 minutes, then check current per tonne.
steps_ms: Rancang penggantian pada henti terancang seterusnya dan maklumkan krew.
Asingkan dan kunci penekan, kemudian buka sangkar penekan.
Ukur sela skru dan kon, bandingkan dengan had haus.
Tukar skru dan lapik kon jika haus; semak dudukan aci.
Tutup, jalankan kosong 10 minit, kemudian semak arus setiap tan.
